text: 创业板指半日涨超1%，创新药概念集体爆发。 恒指半日涨1.1%，恒生科技指数涨1.5%，恒生生物科技指数大涨近7%。 日韩股市在上日大跌后反弹，韩国首尔综指涨超6%，日经225指数涨超1%。 连续第15个月维持不变！8月LPR报价出炉：5年期以上3.5%，1年期3%。 许家印被判处无期徒刑，恒大集团、恒大地产等案一审宣判。 报道：三星计划公布超100万亿韩元股东回报计划。 日本拍卖20年期国债，认购倍数3.98，高于过去12个月均值。 日本7月出口增速创近四年来最快。 长和针对巴拿马启动国际仲裁程序，就投资损失索赔逾15亿美元。 宇树科技王兴兴：具身智能
text_en: ChiNext Index rose over 1% at midday, with innovative drug stocks collectively surging. The Hang Seng Index rose 1.1% at midday, the Hang Seng Tech Index gained 1.5%, and the Hang Seng Biotechnology Index jumped nearly 7%. Japanese and South Korean stocks rebounded after sharp losses the previous day, with Seoul's KOSPI up over 6% and the Nikkei 225 up over 1%. Unchanged for the 15th consecutive month! August LPR quotes released: 5-year and above at 3.5%, 1-year at 3%. Xu Jiayin sentenced to life imprisonment, with first-instance verdicts announced in Evergrande Group and Evergrande Real Estate cases. Reports: Samsung plans to announce a shareholder return program exceeding 100 trillion won. Japan's 20-year bond auction saw a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.98, above the 12-month average. Japan's July export growth was the fastest in nearly four years. CK Hutchison initiated international arbitration proceedings over Panama, claiming over $1.5 billion in investment losses. Unitree's Wang Xingxing: embodied intelligence
